bundle.shortDescription: Knowledge OS — every document is a markdown file
bundle.longDescription: Woodshed is a desktop-first knowledge management app that unifies email, calendar, notes, tasks, resources, and a personal CRM into a single workspace. Every document is a markdown file stored locally on your computer.
